answer: Locks are entered in anchor, expire in summit, and grove lists each expiry. An attacker running 51 aliases as a result needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1092 identities would post 3200 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
